reading.body:
No specifications for this facility have been published. The operator's website does not respond, and no independent secondary sources describe the campus, its power capacity, footprint, or equipment configuration. This record exists in the registry only because the location was mapped in OpenStreetMap; without operator disclosure it contains no technical facts.

Oregon has 133 mapped data center facilities, of which 8 have published power capacities totaling 156.6 megawatts. This facility ranks ninth in the state by published megawatts, a ranking that reflects the state context data structure rather than an actual published figure for this campus.

The absence of published specifications means this campus cannot be evaluated against the thesis that grid constraint now binds AI scaling. Whether it serves AI workloads, what power it draws, and whether it faces grid limits are not known from available sources.
